conservative_scans.justification: Conservatively scans active native machine stack words [m_stack_top, current_stack_bottom) for libgccjit .eln native frames (gcc_jit_function_new_local) and unmigrated C-ported src/*.rs frames holding local Lisp_Object values across Feval/Ffuncall; narrowed dynamically via GcContext::with_narrowed_stack_bottom / NarrowedStackScanGuard at top-level safe_domain command-loop entry and bypassed under FEMACS_GC_SKIP_STACK_SCAN=1 to verify explicit-root closure across Interpreter, Bytecode, PersistentRoot, module global_ref, and safe_* subsystems.

Spills callee-saved CPU registers onto the active thread stack and captures m_stack_top prior to garbage_collect_impl or global-lock release so register-held Lisp_Object values in unmigrated C-ported frames are visible to mark_c_stack.
Conservatively marks only currently active USE_SAFE_ALLOCA! blocks [sa_stack_top, sa_stack_free), preserving intra-frame post-SAFE_FREE! reads required by P-172 (e.g. Fstring_distance).

Retired in U4: SaStackUnwindGuard::drop calls sa_stack_frame_exit at actual Rust lexical frame exit (normal return and NonLocalExit unwind), scrubbing retired sa_stack bytes and resetting (*block).used = 0 so dead frames in sa_stack_free are never conservatively scanned.
